intent: Framed dataset with search, filters, column settings, and a caption title.
useWhen: Searchable datasets with filters or column settings
doNotUseWhen: A short static list — use Table
Dashboard or list-detail activity lists — use Table

toolbar.note: When true, show search + filters + optional Columns

filters.note: Each is a kit DropdownMenu of unique values from that column on the full rows, plus All {label}. Not a native select.

columnSettings.note: Columns button; kit Checkboxes to show/hide columns. Name (or first data column) cannot be hidden. Local state only.

cellSize.note: Passed to every Cell and HeaderCell

columns.note: type number right-aligns cell and header. sortable adds HeaderCell sort (asc, desc, then off). Local state only.

rows.note: Values may be Cell objects (type + fields) or plain string/number (rendered as Cell type=text). Optional row.id if primitive; skip object ids.

bulkActions.note: Shown when selectable and at least one row is checked. kit Buttons. Never primary.

requirements: Row checkboxes ariaLabel like Select Maya Chen; header Select all rows
sortable th aria-sort none | ascending | descending
Narrow container keeps column min-width and scrolls horizontally; the scroller is a focusable region
Narrow container: search full width when filters are present; filter buttons share the row width; Columns stays start-aligned; toolbar actions are not in a horizontal scroller
The filter DropdownMenu trigger is the selected value; when any facet is set, Reset filters is a tertiary kit Button after the filter menus
When rows are selected, a selection row names the count, kit bulk action Buttons, and Clear selection

doNot: Do not use a native select for filters — use kit DropdownMenu
Do not wrap search in Field — DataTable owns its input
Do not invent FilterBar, ColumnPicker, Pagination, or a second Table
Do not invent a local Cell, DataTableCell, HeaderCell, Tag, Trend, FileIcon, or PaymentMethod — use Cell and HeaderCell
Do not use TanStack Table, cmdk, Storybook, Figma, or extra dependencies
Do not put a checkbox on every Cell — row selection stays on DataTable
Do not add pagination, loading, row actions, expandable rows, sticky header, density, or infinite scroll
Do not invent FilterChip, Tag, or a second filter summary — the dropdown trigger is the selected value; Reset filters and selection actions are kit Button
Do not put a primary Button in bulkActions
Do not invent a SortButton or use TanStack Table for sort
Do not squash columns to the container — overflow-x on the scroller
Do not put toolbar actions in a horizontal scroller — search full width, filter buttons fill the row, Columns stays start-aligned
snippet:
<DataTable
  caption="Team members"
  selectable
  toolbar
  searchPlaceholder="Search members..."
  filters={[
    { key: "status", label: "Status" },
    { key: "role", label: "Role" },
  ]}
  columnSettings
  columns={[
    { key: "name", header: "Name", sortable: true },
    { key: "role", header: "Role", sortable: true },
    { key: "status", header: "Status", sortable: true },
    { key: "projects", header: "Projects", type: "number", sortable: true },
  ]}
  rows={rows}
/>
